name: captions
description: Timed transcript from the captions a video site already publishes, through yt-dlp.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: Captions of one video URL. Prefers uploaded captions over automatic ones. Fails with no_captions when the language has neither, and with rate_limited when the site answers HTTP 429. Cached by site, video id, and language.

url.description: Video page URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

verbs.name: parse
verbs.description: Transcript from a json3 caption file already on disk. Cached by file hash and language.

path.description: A json3 caption file, as yt-dlp writes it.

lang.description: Language code to record in the transcript.
